# Browser tests check accessibility

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

Each page a browser test visits is checked with assertAccessible($page, 'what it shows'): axe against WCAG 2.2 AA (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, wcag22aa) at every impact level, after animations settle. A violation that cannot be fixed yet takes an AXE_EXCEPTIONS entry with a reason and an expiry date; AXE_SURVEY=1 prints the violations instead of failing, to size the work.

Kit: none.
